items.title: Hegseth made unannounced visit to Israel, discussed Iran with Netanyahu
items.summary: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth met PM Benjamin Netanyahu and Defense Minister Israel Katz at Ovda Air Base in Israel's Negev desert on Monday, Oct 19, during an unannounced visit — first reported by Axios (two sources) — as Washington and Jerusalem discuss potentially resuming large-scale combat operations against Iran. Reuters independently confirmed the meeting via three Israeli officials and a Netanyahu spokesman (Doron Spielman), who said the pair discussed "the threats in the region" and the US-Israel partnership in dealing with them "both offensively and defensively," plus Trump's support for Netanyahu. CBS News confirmed via a senior US military official and a second Israeli source. Hegseth acknowledged the trip on Oct 20 while speaking with reporters ("they've been good partners") and said US troops are "preparing and ready to ensure that Iran never has a nuclear weapon." Trump, speaking Oct 20, mused: "We just have to make a final decision of which way do we want to win, do we want to win the nice way or the not nice way." The visit came a day after Trump endorsed Netanyahu ahead of Israel's Oct 27 parliamentary election.
